description: From the first report of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a woman U.S. officials suspect of spying for China, through his admission, resignation and reinstatement eleven days later. Dates are as reported; allegations that were reported but not confirmed are worded as such.

events.description: The New York Times reports that U.S. intelligence officials concluded Megaspeed executive Alice Huang was an informant for Beijing, and that she had a close relationship with Jensen Huang. Nvidia denies the relationship was out of the ordinary.

events.description: In a letter to employees, Huang writes: 'I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.' The board opens an independent investigation into reports he was the target of a foreign intelligence effort.
